scenes.text: One apostrophe let anyone log in as anyone. Claude caught it in your login code.
Your lookup pasted the email straight into the SQL. Whatever someone types becomes part of the query.
Type quote OR one equals one. Now the WHERE clause reads: blank email, or one equals one. False or true. Always true.
Every row matches, so the database hands back every user.
Claude switched to a parameterized query. The SQL holds a placeholder, dollar one, and the email travels separately as pure data.
